propositions: Signed plan-material pins must serve as the single validity check across attestation lifecycle consumers with safe rollout via optional enforcement configuration.
Pin health derivation and enforcement must distinguish malformed-pin, stale-pin-missing, stale-pin-drift, and current status with inherited target severity aggregation.

When enforcement is enabled, pin drift or missing/malformed targets invalidate claim, reuse, and drift-refresh consumers; when disabled, the same observations remain advisory without changing valid status.
Re-sign recovery must validate review-time sidecar-persisted related material through pin-health derivation before signing, without requiring a certified attestation.
Validity profiles (DEFAULT, CLOSE, DRIFT_REFRESH) must selectively disable code freshness while retaining signature, registry, own-material, and pin checks.
Legacy unpinned attestations and pre-feature sidecars must remain valid across configuration toggles and be treated as such without raising exceptions.
